name: value-v2-100k

gate.primary: pooled AUC of the network on the 5,000 test games' end-of-turn rows minus the better of the served leaf and shared score; game-clustered bootstrap 95% LCB > 0

cross_eval_predeclared: Once runs/pv2-data-v1 exists, this model is also scored with the pv2 within-decision gate on the pv2 test decisions (picked candidate's 24-playout win rate minus the served candidate's, game-clustered LCB). That answers whether 100k on-policy outcome data with encoder v2 orders a decision's options; it is reported alongside pv2-train and is not a substitute for it.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-05 before any re-encoding or test read (Jerry: train a model first on the 100k with the audit fixes). Applies encoder v2 (fix 3/4) to the 100k on-policy value data by deterministic replay (each replayed row verified against the stored row's legacy features). It cannot apply the counterfactual-support fix (on-policy data only) or the within-decision gate on its own data; hence the predeclared cross-eval on pv2 test decisions. Every third end-of-turn row per game (deterministic offset). Epoch chosen on the last 5,000 train games; no other tuning.
